content: Besides, some other research studies do not disentangle style from content but directly learn representations of sentences. In BIBREF8 , authors propose a dual reinforcement learning framework without separating content and style representations. In BIBREF7 , researchers utilize a machine translation model to learn a sentence representation preserving the meaning of the sentence but reducing stylistic properties. In this method, the quality of generated sentences relies on the performance of classifiers to a large extent. Meanwhile, such models are usually sensitive to parameters and difficult to train. In contrast, we combine a pre-training process with reinforcement learning to build up a stable language model and design special rewards for our task.
